Name: Alex Stop Being Cringe
Author: amazinglyegg
Description:
Are you tired of Alex talking about your bikini? Do you wish to be seen as both sporty AND cute in his eyes? Well this is the mod for you!

"Alex, Stop Being Cringe!" Changes a few of Alex's lines to remove, alter, or make all gender-based dialogue universal, as well as changes lines that equates reading to intelligence.

Open up the spoiler tag here to see every single line I altered!

[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Both farmers: Get called "more sensitive" and his "best friend" in his eight heart beach scene
[*]Both farmers: Get both "resort_chair" lines with a 50% chance (not sure why this was gendered in the first place?)
[*]Both farmers: Get complimented on their "sportiness" and "hair" with a 50% chance
[*]Both farmers: Get asked if they like Alex's haircut
[*]Both farmers: Will be called a "cute couple" and that they "look beautiful" with a 50% chance (marriage dialogue)
[*]Removes: Asking about the female farmer's bikini
[*]Removes: Line saying he won't play catch with the female farmer because "you're a girl"
[*]Removes: Comment about the female farmer's pants
[*]Removes: Female farmer being called "fit" instead of strong
[*]Removes: Female farmer getting a salad instead of a linguini during his ten heart event at the saloon
[/list]
ALSO:
[list]
[*]Alters his five heart event: Instead of claiming he "won't get anywhere in life" without reading and that he feels "worthless", he says that he's worried people "won't take him seriously" if he doesn't read and that he'll "never succeed". Afterwards he says he wants to discuss books with you instead of "phil-os-ophy"
[*]Alters a high-heart line: Instead of claiming he's "neglecting his brain" by not reading, he says he's neglecting to pick up new hobbies
[*]Alters a marriage dialogue: Instead of saying he'll be "stagnant" without reading, he will ask for book suggestions from you.
[/list][/spoiler]


I haven't had the ability to test every single line, so if any don't play the way they should or just generally sound awkward, let me know!

This is also my first ever published mod, so please be easy on me :D
